description: This Swift source file defines the data structures and logic for managing and retrieving a list of nodes within an application, including network request handling, state management, and logging.

classes.name: NodesStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing the list of nodes, their retrieval from the network, and associated state, including automatic periodic refresh.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the periodic refresh of node data, starting a detached loop if not already running.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the latest list of nodes from the network and updates internal state accordingly.
